title: Restructure the Benefits Package Registry data model
requirements:
- Define a rule model with terminology bindings, distinguishing computable rules from human-interpreted policy
- Distinguish package, scheme, item, exclusion, condition, cost-sharing and authority, with structured equity-relevant conditions and versioning
- Note accreditation process and results, and the overlap with facility registries
- Specify product concept levels, generics and substitution rules for medicines
- Specify conformance artefacts (test cases, expected outcomes, API)
- Require effective-dated, immutable versions for evaluation against past dates
